parse_error_from_status_code: parse an HTTP status code and JSON payload into the appropriate text generation inference exception
handle_generation_error: catch and handle a GenerationError exception when text generation fails on the server
handle_validation_error: catch and handle a ValidationError exception when the request input is invalid
handle_overloaded_error: catch and handle an OverloadedError exception when the inference server is overloaded
handle_rate_limit_error: catch and handle a RateLimitExceededError exception when the API rate limit is exceeded
